**Urgent: ICLR Revision & Ablation**

- **Rewrite‑vs‑Append ablation**  
  - *Goal*: Compare structured memory rewrite (SR) vs naive append (NA) + periodic consolidation (PC).  
  - *Baseline*: Use MemGPT virtual context paging (8e3bb063) as NA to match compute cost of SR.  
  - *Compute*: 200 H100‑GPU‑hrs from the 2400‑hour quota.  
  - *Schedule*: Start experiments 16:00 on **Day 16** (Wed 26th). Run immediately after each Wednesday 11:00 lab meeting to hit the 20 % turnaround boost.  
  - *Milestones*:  
    - Data preprocessing & log setup: 17:00‑19:00 Day 16.  
    - Run 5 seeds (3×SR, 3×NA+PC, 3×NA) – completion: Day 18 14:00.  
    - Analysis & statistical test: Day 18 15:00‑17:00.  
    - Draft rebuttal section: Day 18 17:00‑18:30.  
  - *Draft*: *“We have begun the SR vs NA+PC ablation and expect to have statistically significant results by Day 18. The analysis will be integrated into the rebuttal under the ‘Methodology’ section.”*  
  - **Deadline**: Day 19 – rebuttal submission must include ablation results.

- **Lab‑meeting adjustment**  
  - Wednesday 11:00 slot now dedicated to ablation QA and troubleshooting.  
  - Thursday 14:00 (30 min) added for a quick post‑experiment check‑in; will be used to confirm data integrity before writing the rebuttal.

**Overnight idea**

> *Conf=0.78*: Structured memory rewrite gains are largely due to virtual context paging (MemGPT) and periodic consolidation.  
> Propose a new baseline: NA + paging + consolidation (no rewrite).  This will confirm whether paging alone can match or exceed SR + PC performance.

**Next Actions**

- Allocate and confirm the 200 H100‑GPU‑hrs block (contact HPC).  
- Finalize the experiment configuration script (in repo commit `b27ddc46`).  
- Notify team of the Wednesday/Thursday meeting changes.  
- Update rebuttal draft template with ablation section placeholders.

*All tasks flagged as “In Progress” are tracked in the project board.*
